title: xDPearlCoolDown
description: xDPearlCooldown improves gameplay balance by limiting how often players can use Ender Pearls, making combat more strategic and fair while staying lightweight and easy to use for server owners.
body:
xDPearlCooldown is a fast and reliable cooldown management plugin designed to control Ender Pearl usage and other player actions with precision. It gives server owners full control over cooldown timing, helping maintain fair gameplay and preventing spam or abuse of abilities.
Built for performance and simplicity, xDPearlCooldown integrates smoothly into any server setup with easy configuration and minimal overhead. Players receive clear cooldown feedback, ensuring a balanced and user-friendly experience without confusion.
